assertions.text: Output notices the body is over 2,000 characters before showing the preview
Output does not write the over-limit text as a property value and does not truncate it silently
Output offers or applies the shorten-with-the-user or move-to-page-content route
If it moves the text into page content, output splits it with wmgt_split_blocks.py using a generated scratchpad file name (not the repository root, not a name built from the record's content)
If it plans a read-back after a page-content write, the check is paragraph count and the closing sentence, not a block count
Output still requires live approval before the write
Every tool this skill itself plans to call is within its allowed-tools
